<!-- GER1E-DOC-SCHEMA: v1 -->
<a id="hunt-change"></a>
<div align="center">

<strong>Hunt / change</strong><br/>
<sub>GER1E // THREAT HUNTING LAB // DOCUMENTATION</sub>

</div>

Describe the behavior, detection, CTI normalization, documentation, or tooling change.

<a id="hypothesis"></a>
<sub><strong>01 // Hypothesis</strong></sub>

What falsifiable attacker behavior is being tested or improved?

<a id="telemetry"></a>
<sub><strong>02 // Telemetry</strong></sub>

List required tables / data sources and any assumptions about retention or coverage.

<a id="attck"></a>
<sub><strong>03 // ATT&CK</strong></sub>

Map only techniques directly supported by the behavior.

<a id="analyst-value"></a>
<sub><strong>04 // Analyst value</strong></sub>

What should an analyst be able to decide or investigate from the output?

<a id="false-positives-tuning"></a>
<sub><strong>05 // False positives / tuning</strong></sub>

List expected legitimate collisions and safe tuning options.

<a id="provenance"></a>
<sub><strong>06 // Provenance</strong></sub>

Link original public CTI, vendor, government, academic, or technical sources where applicable.

<a id="safety-check"></a>
<sub><strong>07 // Safety check</strong></sub>

- [ ] No customer or private production data
- [ ] No credentials, secrets, tenant IDs, or internal infrastructure
- [ ] No unpublished incident evidence
- [ ] Query is sanitized and reproducible
- [ ] Required hunt header is present

<p align="center"><sub>GER1E // THREAT HUNTING LAB // MOBILE-SAFE DOCUMENTATION</sub></p>
